Streaming chat completion via the AWS Bedrock provider using the bedrock/ prefix — verifies SSE chunks are yielded and assembled correctly from the Converse streaming API

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const liter_llm = @import("liter_llm");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _api_key = std.c.getenv("API_KEY") orelse return error.MissingApiKey;
    var _client = try liter_llm.create_client(std.mem.span(_api_key), null, null, null, null);
    defer _client.free();
    const _result_json = try _client.chat_stream("{\"max_tokens\":32,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count to three, one word per response.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0\",\"stream\":true}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
